text: Can you bastards stop walking through my land?!
zh: 你们这帮混蛋能不能别从我的地里走？！

text:
Damn it!
This ain't a circus!
zh:
该死！
这儿又不是马戏团！

text: Calm down.
zh: 冷静点。

text: Are you always this friendly?
zh: 你平时都这么友善吗？

text: Calm down?!
zh: 冷静点？！

text: Open your mouth once more, and I'll shove my pitchfork in there as far as it goes!
zh: 你再敢张嘴，我就把草叉捅进你嘴里，能捅多深捅多深！

text: Ever since the king made this god damn road through my farm, there's always someone passin' through.
zh: 自打国王把这条天杀的路修穿了我的农场，就总有人从这儿过。

text: Always some soldiers, travellers or beggars.
zh: 不是士兵，就是旅人，再不然就是乞丐。

text: Some of them even end up stealing my wheat or some chicken!
zh: 有些家伙甚至偷我的麦子和鸡！

text: By god... I just about had enough of all this bullshit!
zh: 老天爷……这些破事我真是受够了！

text: Huh?
zh: 嗯？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Is this your farm?
zh: 这是你的农场吗？

text: Who do you work for?
zh: 你为谁干活？

text: Do you have something to sell?
zh: 你有什么东西要卖吗？

text: I saw a huge shadow recently.
zh: 我最近看到了一个巨大的影子。

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: No, this is my chicken's farm.
zh: 不，这是我家鸡的农场。

text: Of course it's MINE, you dumbass!
zh: 当然是我的，你这蠢货！

text: My late father and I built this place up with our own bare hands!
zh: 这地方是我和我过世的父亲亲手一点点建起来的！

text: Only stuff I don't need myself.
zh: 只卖我自己用不着的东西。

text: Stay away from my chicken and fields!
zh: 离我的鸡和田地远点！

text:
That's true.
Somethin' flew over my land towards the south.
zh:
确有其事。
有个什么东西从我的地上空飞过去了，往南边去了。

text: Rumors say it was a dragon.
zh: 有传言说那是一条龙。

text: Never saw a dragon myself, so I ain't inclined to believe that shit.
zh: 我自己从没见过龙，所以才不信那套鬼话。

text:
Why do you want to know?
Do you want to set your friends on me?
zh:
你问这个干什么？
想叫你的朋友来对付我？

text: The good ol' #:Roland:# knows how to defend himself.
zh: 老#:罗兰:#我可懂得怎么保护自己。

text: You better watch out!
zh: 你最好小心点！

text: For all the people in the capital and, obviously, for our BELOVED king.
zh: 为王都的所有人干活，当然啦，还有我们“敬爱的”国王。

text: At least I don't have to pay taxes due to my work.
zh: 至少凭这份活计，我不用交税。

text:
Every once in a while the wizards of the academy want somethin' as well.
Unlike the king, they pay properly.
zh:
学院的法师们偶尔也会来要点东西。
跟国王不一样，他们给钱倒是爽快。

text: And now leave me alone. I still have a lot to do.
zh: 行了，别烦我了。我还有一堆活儿要干。
